newsitem.title: CHILE: CTC says VTR deal may be agreed August.
newsitem.headline: CTC says VTR deal may be agreed August.

text.p: The merger between Compania de Telecomunicacions de Chile and VTR Telecomunicaciones may be finalized this month, said CTC's general manager Jacinto Diaz.
"We are putting the finishing touches to the negotiations... the work is normal as in whatever type of negotiation," Diaz told reporters at a telecom seminar in Santiago.
"There are no time limits. We always have the objective of finishing as soon as possible, but logically you can't anticipate results."
Diaz said he hoped the talks, which began several months ago, could be completed in August.

Once the deal is agreed, it will have to be approved by Chile's antimonopolies commission which is already investigating the impact of the deal -- the largest in the country's telecom history -- on the Chilean market.
CTC, Chile's largest telephone carrier, is 43-percent owned by Spain's Telefonica de Espana. U.S. operator SBC Communications owns 40 percent of VTR.
CTC and VTR merged their wireless telephone operations last year.
